question: Will excess salary be recovered from staff who were late with the computer certificate?
gold_answer: The recovery order of 26-11-2020 was stayed on 27-11-2020; no newer order in this corpus

gold_grs_detail.title: Decision regarding final date for submission of compulsory computer qualification certificate and recovery of excess payment.
Stay order for GR issued on 26 November 2020 about the decision regarding final date for submission of compulsory computer qualification certificate and recovery of excess payment.

raw.answer: The 26 November 2020 GR (202011261535430611) decided that excess salary paid because increments were not withheld from staff who failed to submit the computer certificate on time should be recovered. However, the 27 November 2020 GR (202011271209526511) stayed that decision until further orders and restored the earlier 20 November 2018 letter orders, meaning recovery was suspended. No later GR in the corpus amends or replaces this.
